chunks: From the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)
Whoever preserves forty of our narrations, Allah will raise him on the Day of Judgment as a scholar possessing understanding.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for memorizing forty hadiths according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this hadith is often cited to validate the authority of solitary reports (khabar al-wahid) from the Imams, provided the narrator is trustworthy, thereby establishing a foundation for independent jurisprudence. The specific number forty is significant in Islamic tradition as the threshold for attaining expertise, linking the preservation of these narrations directly to the emergence of qualified jurists (fuqaha) capable of deriving legal rulings.
